title: main admitted a merge while a gate run at the merged head was red by the repository's own platform reader
claim: Of the 52 merges in round 11's window, 1 (#3618) reached main while a check suite at its merged head carried a red latest `gate` run (CI code run 43734029821, gate failed 19:18:44Z, its codeql/Analyze (python) still running and later failed) and 1 (#3644) while a gate re-run was in progress; `merge_train.platform_gate`, documented as GitHub's own required-check evaluation, reads #3618 red, so the ruleset's required `gate` check does not enforce what the train assumes it enforces.
mechanism: main-protect-checks requires the context `gate` (integration 15368). Every ci.yml run (edit, review, code, dispatched code) publishes its own `gate` check run in its own check suite at the head. GitHub admitted the merge with four suites' gates green and the dispatched code run's gate red; the train's platform_gate requires every required gate run to pass. The only refusal of a red-gate merge is therefore client-side (merge_train / merge_pr.sh), which a merge under the owner account outside the train does not pass through.

evidence.unit: merges not green at merged_at (1 red, 1 wait)
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats on the box; counts over fixed snapshots, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb: add FAILURE to merge_train.PLATFORM_PASS (the reader accepts a red gate run)

metric_definition: count of window merges whose merged head, at merged_at, platform_gate reads not green over each check suite's latest gate run completed by then
phenomenon_property: No merge reaches main while any check suite at the merged head carries a red or unfinished latest `gate` run; the platform, not only the train, refuses it.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D11/s2/gate_at_merge.py (one line per merge in the window not green at merged_at)

null_control.note: the same reader over the same snapshot is green for the other 50, so the reader is not red by construction

reproduction_steps: api/pr3618_gate_runs.json: suite 118403819214 (run 43734029821, workflow_dispatch 'CI code') latest gate before 19:51:14Z is failure; merged_by tvofi
proposed_fix_scope: Make the platform refuse it: either one gate per head (the code run's gate the only check run named `gate`, the others renamed), or a required check whose single run reads every suite at the head; and record in decision 0011/0013 that platform_gate is stricter than GitHub so a non-train merge is not covered.
